nina.docs: opened PR #1222 — tidy rate-limit examples, fix dashboard links, and swap SDK header examples to Bearer tokens. Preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1222 :memo:

omar: quick summary of changes?

nina.docs: (1) replace 'requests/min' examples with tokens-per-second and a short worked calc; (2) update curl/Node/Python snippets to use Authorization: Bearer; (3) add 301 redirects for three old anchors that external docs still link to; (4) small FAQ clarifying burst credits vs sustained throughput.

kevin: pasted a compact curl example for the snippet page:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}'
```

tara: redirect rules look fine but change them to 301. Also add a note to support with mappings so they can update customer KB.

nina.docs: changed to 301 and added a support note. sample _redirects lines added: "#/old/docs#tiers  /docs/quota#credits  301" and "#/billing/old#rate-limits  /docs/rate-limits#faq  301"

deploybot: preview succeeded — https://deploy-preview-1222--docs.redwood.ai. Linkcheck passed; snippets render; redirects tested.

nina.docs: merging in 5min unless anyone objects. I'll follow up with a changelog blurb and support note. Thanks! :tada:
